newsitem.title: CANADA: Tomato products seen boosting health.
newsitem.headline: Tomato products seen boosting health.

text.p: Pour on the ketchup and ladle the tomato sauce onto the pasta.
These tomato products are good for you, according to a just completed study that has not yet been published.

"What we are suggesting ... is that making tomato products part of a daily diet is compatible with good health," said Venket Lao, professor of nutritional sciences at the University of Toronto Faculty of Medicine.
Such products contain lycopene, which is a carotenoid and an antioxidant -- as is beta-carotene, the Vitamin A derivative in carrots and broccoli.
Antioxidants are proven to fight ageing, cancer and other forms of disease, Rao said. His one-year study of 20 healthy subjects proved that lycopenes were antioxidants.
The research found the best way to get the disease-fighting compound was through processed foods such as ketchup, tomato juice and spaghetti sauce.
With uncooked tomatoes, people cannot make use of lycopene as effectively. But the extreme heat of processing changes the substance into a form that is efficiently used by the body.
Rao said he did the study after researchers at the Harvard School of Medicine discovered that people who ate tomatoes and tomato products frequently had a diminished risk of prostate cancer.
"They tested many different foods and only tomatoes showed this relationship. So we said, 'What is it about tomatoes? What is its unique feature?'" Rao said.
Rao and his team will next look at lycopene levels in cancer patients and how lycopene acts on the disease.
